description: Header file defining data structures, enums, and function prototypes for a QR Code generator library in C.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeText
methods.description: Encodes a UTF-8 string into a QR Code symbol with specified error correction level and mask pattern.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeBinary
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a QR Code symbol with specified error correction level and mask pattern.

methods.name: qrcodegen_isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded as an alphanumeric QR Code segment.

methods.name: qrcodegen_isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be encoded as a numeric QR Code segment.

methods.name: qrcodegen_calcSegmentBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates the buffer size needed for a QR Code segment with given mode and character count.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeBytes
methods.description: Creates a QR Code segment from binary data.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeNumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR Code segment from a numeric string.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeAlphanumeric
methods.description: Creates a QR Code segment from an alphanumeric string.

methods.name: qrcodegen_makeEci
methods.description: Creates a QR Code segment for an Extended Channel Interpretation (ECI) designator.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeSegments
methods.description: Generates a QR Code from multiple data segments with specified error correction level.

methods.name: qrcodegen_encodeSegmentsAdvanced
methods.description: Generates a QR Code from multiple data segments with detailed encoding parameters.

methods.name: qrcodegen_getSize
methods.description: Returns the size (side length) of a QR Code.

methods.name: qrcodegen_getModule
methods.description: Returns the color (black/white) of a specific module in the QR Code.
